- Player controls now appear the instant you tap. Before, every tap waited about a third of a second in case it was a double-tap.
- Double-tapping the left or right side still skips 10 seconds. While the skip indicator is showing, single taps on the same side keep skipping, like YouTube.
- The controls fade in a little faster.

Installs over v1.1.0 and later directly. If you're still on v1.0.0, uninstall it first; it was signed with a different key.
